description: A painted portrait of an older East Asian man with short dark hair and a thin goatee, in a loose brown-grey robe with a crossed collar, seated inside a rocky cave opening. Behind him is a dark blue-grey night sky with misty mountain silhouettes. Oil-painting style, dim lighting, one hand resting on his knee. No visible text apart from a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
